question: KP 15 is related to NL 7 in a certain way. In the same way, BL 5 is related to EH -3. To which of the given options is RP 18 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

KP 15 is related to NL 7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/407ab7e3ce1c4f7315e6cfb52ebb0db3c20defb02ba71d84a86248a28b4b6c71.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce39f8a2b8cba95fd58b2a4f46b52721e4c62e5c6208c0531bae7c255eb9687d.png]
